digest.component_or_area: outbound parent-clear via Epic Link path; Jira DC integration probe
propositions: test_outbound_clear_parent_round_trips fails because it attempts to clear a subtask parent via the standard parent path, but the Epic Link path (which DC accepts) is reachable as an alternative.
Whether {epic_link_field_id: None} actually clears on DC 8.17.1 is untested and must be verified before re-homing the cell to the Epic Link path.
The probe polls /rest/api/2/serverInfo for readiness but this predicate is too weak; custom fields like Epic Link may not be registered yet despite serverInfo returning 200.
The non-sub-task branch of set_parent lacks read-back verification to detect silent no-ops when clearing the Epic Link, unlike the sub-task branch.

Three reds in the live DC suite stem from three distinct platform limitations: outbound parent-clear (addressable), outbound subtask parent-set (unreachable), and inbound subtask parent-set (adoption target).
